description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the number of code retrievals for different sources of code documentation. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens" and is on a linear scale ranging from 200 to 900 tokens. The y-axis is labeled "Number of Code Retrievals" and is on a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40 retrievals. The plot includes four lines representing different sources: Tutorials (blue line with circle markers), Library Documentation (red line with square markers), StackOverflow posts (yellow line with diamond markers), and Github files (green line with triangle markers). The Tutorials line starts at approximately 20 retrievals at 200 tokens, peaks at around 40 retrievals at 600 tokens, and then declines to about 30 retrievals at 900 tokens. The Library Documentation line begins at around 30 retrievals at 200 tokens, peaks at approximately 35 retrievals at 600 tokens, and then slightly declines to about 33 retrievals at 900 tokens. The StackOverflow posts line starts at around 10 retrievals at 200 tokens, peaks at about 20 retrievals at 600 tokens, and then sharply declines to 0 retrievals at 900 tokens. The Github files line begins at approximately 25 retrievals at 200 tokens, peaks at around 30 retrievals at 600 tokens, and then declines to about 20 retrievals at 900 tokens.
